url_scraper_js_fallback - fail (environment regression) - evidence: POST /api/analyses url https://quotes.toscrape.com/js/ returned word_count=7 (static-only), backend logs show 'render fallback failed ... Executable doesn't exist at /pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1234/chrome-linux/headless_shell'. Actual installed browser is chromium_headless_shell-1208; PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH is not visible to the supervisor-run backend so os.environ.get returns None and Playwright uses its (mismatched) default. Not in iteration 3 scope but recorded.

minor.issue: Playwright package upgraded to expect chromium build 1234 but the container has 1208 at /pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1208. server.py reads PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH via os.environ.get() at import time, but supervisor's backend process does not inherit PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium from the shell env. Result: render_html() launches Playwright without executable_path override -> BrowserType.launch fails -> normalize_content falls back to static-only HTML (word_count 7 for quotes.toscrape.com/js/). Fix: either (a) add PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium to /app/backend/.env, or (b) hardcode the path fallback in render_html when PW_EXECUTABLE is empty, or (c) rerun playwright install chromium to match version 1234.

action_items: Fix Playwright/browser version mismatch: add PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium to /app/backend/.env (persistent across supervisor restarts), OR run `playwright install chromium` to install the 1234 build the current package expects. Currently JS-heavy URL analysis silently degrades to static-only fetch. This regressed since iteration 2 (which had it passing with word_count=249).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: apply_entitlements() implementation is clean and applied in all 3 auth exit points (register, login, get_current_user). Good pattern.

server.py _run_domain_analysis: catches all exceptions and stores status='error'+error message on the job doc. domain_get returns 404 only when doc is truly missing, so the UI can distinguish error vs processing vs done. Good.

domain_analyze creates the job doc THEN spawns asyncio.create_task(...). If the request is cancelled after insert but before create_task (extremely narrow), no worker runs and the job stays 'processing' forever. Consider a heartbeat/timeout sweeper or refuse to accept new jobs older than N minutes still marked processing.

_filter_prompts_to_topics uses `pt == t or pt in t or t in pt` — this is generous (substring both directions). Works for the current use case but could accept a very short/generic topic string as matching almost anything. Consider tightening to `pt in t or t == pt` (subset only).

llm_json now accepts max_tokens; domain uses 8000. Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4-6 supports this but be aware max_tokens=8000 with a ~50-item structured response can occasionally truncate JSON — the JSON regex salvage at line 283 catches most, but a hard truncation mid-value still 502s. Iteration 3 empirically OK.
server.py has grown to 764 lines. Same recommendation as iteration 2: split into routers/*.py + services/*.py for maintainability.

DomainAnalysis.js polling uses setInterval every 3s. Consider adding an upper-bound (e.g. stop after 3 min) and displaying a 'still working…' hint after 60s. Right now if a job hangs it polls forever.
DomainAnalysis.js pollRef cleanup on unmount is present. Also clears when new run() is invoked. Good.
SUPERADMIN_EMAILS is a Python set literal at module scope — safe/immutable per import. If future need arises to add more, consider environment-driven list.

rca of the issue: url_scraper_js_fallback failure RCA: (1) In iteration 2, environment had Playwright package version matching the chromium_headless_shell-1208 build present in /pw-browsers. (2) Between iter2 and iter3, Playwright package was updated -> now looks for chromium_headless_shell-1234. (3) server.py has a workaround: `PW_EXECUTABLE = os.environ.get('PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH')`, and `/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium` symlinks to the installed 1208 build. (4) BUT supervisor does not inherit that env var from the login shell; it's only set for interactive users. Backend imports server.py under supervisor -> PW_EXECUTABLE=None -> Playwright launches its default which points at the missing 1234 build -> fallback fails silently. Mitigation: add `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium` to /app/backend/.env and restart backend.
